footnote_1981: *72:1-28 The messenger here is named, mathematically, as "Rashad Khalifa," to whom God revealed the end of the world (Appendix 25). The number of verses from 1:1 to 72:27, where the messenger is mentioned, is 5472, 19x72x4. The word "Rashada" occurs 4 times in Sura 72. The value of "Rashada" is 504, and 504+28 (verses of Sura 72) is 532, 19x28. The value of "Rashad Khalifa" (1230)+72+28=1330 =19x70. text_1981: ‘It guides to righteousness, so we believed in it and will never set up idols besides our Lord.
text_1989: “ ‘It guides to righteousness, and we have believed in it; we will never set up any idols besides
text_ref: "'It guides to righteousness, and we have believed in it; we will never set up any idols besides our Lord.

text_1981: ‘He is the most high; our one and only Lord; never did He have a spouse, nor a son.
text_1989: “ ‘The Most High is our only Lord. He never had a mate, nor a son.
text_ref: "'The Most High is our only Lord. He never had a mate, nor a son.

text_1981: ‘It was the fool among us who used to utter such blasphemies about God.
text_1989: “ ‘It is the foolish among us who used to utter such nonsense about GOD.
text_ref: "'It is the foolish among us who used to utter such nonsense about GOD.

text_1981: ‘We never thought that the humans and the jinns could utter lies about God.
text_1989: “ ‘We thought that neither the humans, nor the jinns, could possibly utter lies about GOD.
text_ref: "'We thought that neither the humans, nor the jinns, could possibly utter lies about GOD.

text_1981: ‘Some human beings used to seek benefits from jinn beings, but they only gave them problems.
text_1989: “ ‘Human beings used to seek power through jinn beings, but they only afflicted them with a lot of adversity.
text_ref: "'Human beings used to seek power through jinn beings, but they only afflicted them with a lot of adversity.

text_1981: ‘They thought, just like you thought, that God will not resurrect anyone.
text_1989: “ ‘They thought, just like you thought, that GOD would not send another (messenger).
text_ref: "'They thought, just like you thought, that GOD would not send another (messenger).

text_1981: ‘And we tried to touch the heaven, but we find it full of mighty guards and projectiles.
text_1989: “ ‘We touched the heaven and found it filled with formidable guards and projectiles.
text_ref: "'We touched the heaven and found it filled with formidable guards and projectiles.

text_1981: ‘We used to sneak therein to listen; now, anyone who listens is immedi¬ ately pursued by a projectile.
text_1989: “ ‘We used to sit there in order to spy. by a powerful projectile.
text_ref: "'We used to sit there in order to spy. Anyone who listens is pursued by a powerful projectile.

text_1981: ‘And we have no idea whether those on earth are destined for disaster or if their Lord plans something good for them.
text_1989: “ ‘We have no idea if something bad is intended for the inhabitants of Earth, or if their Lord wills to redeem them.
text_ref: "'We have no idea if something bad is intended for the inhabitants of Earth, or if their Lord wills to redeem them.

text_1981: ‘Some of us are righteous and some are less than righteous.
text_1989: “ ‘Some of us are righteous, and some are less than righteous; we follow various paths.
text_ref: "'Some of us are righteous, and some are less than righteous; we follow various paths.

text_1981: ‘We know that we can never escape from God or flee from Him.
text_1989: “ ‘We knew full well that we can never run away from GOD on earth; we can never run away and escape.
text_ref: "'We knew full well that we can never run away from GOD on earth; we can never run away and escape.
